summary_en: SIGMAXYZ Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 3.6 million shares (4.4% of outstanding shares) for a maximum 18 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between January 1 and June 30, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, the Board of Directors of SIGMAXYZ Holdings Inc. authorized the acquisition of treasury shares under the Company's Articles of Incorporation pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act. The authorization permits acquisition of up to 3.6 million ordinary shares, representing 4.4% of outstanding shares (81,472,813 shares as of September 30, 2026), at a maximum cost of 18 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from January 1, 2027 to June 30, 2027.

The company stated that the primary objectives of this buyback are to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, while maintaining flexibility in executing capital policies. The funding will be sourced from existing cash reserves and operating cash flows. The company separately disclosed on the same date that it will dispose of treasury shares through third-party allocation to Itochu Corporation; however, the acquisition program is expressly not funded by proceeds from that stock disposal.
